• IDEAS:
- Olive Harvest: Grandma orders olive smashing; Rappit fails a tough-guy chop, deadpans while bulldog eats them.
- Independence Day (Nov 22): Rappit films stoic cedar tree tribute; bulldog ruins it by chewing branches.
- Slowed+Reverb Arabic Walk: Epic slow-mo hallway walk shattered by Grandma smacking Rappit with a newspaper.
- AI Rakweh Mess: Bulldog boils Arabic coffee, breaking AI physics into a tsunami while Rappit casually sips a finjan.
- "Loading..." Trend: 0% to 100% Lebanese wedding guest glow-up; bulldog provides leaf-blower wind effects.

• METRICS (Works vs Flops):
- Works: High-retention 10s visual punchlines. Oct 26 (1.8k views, 10s watch) and Oct 22 (1.4k views) drove highest traffic, but relied on axed mafia themes. Oct 31 Dabke sets our new cultural visual joke benchmark despite lower initial reach.
- Flops: Static images (Oct 21/23 got ~2 reach) and vague tough-guy lore (Oct 12, 127 views) completely fail to engage.

• AVOID:
- Mafia, tax, or business negotiation tropes.
- Serialized melodrama or cliffhangers.
- Static image posts.

ideas.title: The Shared Water Tank
ideas.cast: Lil Rappit, Abu Lakma, Abu Sleiman
ideas.setup: On the roof, Rappit stands guard over one tin water tank like a VIP bouncer, boasting to Abu Sleiman that he controls the village water supply.
ideas.punchline: Abu Lakma waddles out from behind the tank with a massive water-filled belly and burps loudly just as the tap runs dry, leaving Rappit staring silently into the camera.
ideas.rappit_line: Ana l mas2oul 3an el may hon ya mukhtar, ma hada byeshrab bala 2emdayti!
ideas.english: I am in charge of the water here Mukhtar, nobody drinks without my signature!

ideas.title: The Olive Harvest
ideas.setup: Sitting by one plastic tarp, Rappit tries to impress Teta by aggressively karate-chopping a pile of green olives, while Abu Lakma quietly eats them whole.
ideas.punchline: Teta calmly raises one plastic slipper in the air, and Rappit instantly drops his tough-guy act to frantically sort the olives with his tiny paws.
ideas.rappit_line: Ya Teta, hal zaytounat baddon 2ouweh w haybeh, msh 7ayalla shoghol!
ideas.english: Teta, these olives need strength and prestige, not just any work!

ideas.title: The Flirting Fox
ideas.setup: At the dekkene, Abu Fahd slyly offers one fresh carrot to Lola while twisting his moustache, prompting Rappit to step between them to defend his territory.
ideas.punchline: Rappit delivers a very serious warning to Abu Fahd, but instinctively snatches the offered carrot from the fox's paw and eats it in one bite, maintaining a deadpan stare while chewing.
ideas.rappit_line: Wlak ba33id idak 3an Lola ya Abu Fahd, el day3a kella bta3rifni!
ideas.english: Keep your hand away from Lola, Abu Fahd, the whole village knows me!

ideas.title: The Moteur Cord
ideas.cast: Lil Rappit, Abu Lakma, Umm Lakma
ideas.setup: During a village power cut, Rappit confidently commands Abu Lakma to pull the cord on one red generator to save the evening football match.
ideas.punchline: Abu Lakma pulls so hard that the entire cord rips out of the machine; when Umm Lakma yells angrily from the window, Rappit silently points right at Abu Lakma and slowly backs away.
ideas.rappit_line: Es7ab el 7ableh w dawweh el moteur, khalli el jiran tshouf el m3allem!
ideas.english: Pull the rope and start the generator, let the neighbors see the boss!

ideas.title: The Wasta Parking
ideas.setup: In the village square, Rappit fiercely guards one white plastic chair, using it to reserve a prime parking spot for Lola while acting like he owns the streets.
ideas.punchline: Umm Lakma waddles over, completely ignores Rappit's shouting, and comfortably sits on the plastic chair; Rappit instantly pretends he was just keeping the seat warm for her.
ideas.rappit_line: Wlak mamnou3 el w2ouf hon, hal mahal ma7jouz la sayaret Lola!
ideas.english: Parking is forbidden here, this spot is reserved for Lola's car!
